author: Ankit
problem: Return the length of the longest run of consecutive days whose spending did not go over the budget.
bug_description: Uses amount < budget instead of amount <= budget, so a day that spends exactly the budget breaks the run.

comments.accurate: Longest run of consecutive days with spending at or below the budget
comments.wrong_behavior: Longest run of consecutive days with spending under the budget
comments.wrong_location: Budget check verified; make sure the streak resets after an over-budget day
